name: 037.1 — the restructure: LIVE is hafen.world, RECORDED is hafen.map
author: brodgar
description: Self-checking suite for task 037.1: the thirteen terrain/coordinate functions moved to hafen.world and answer there, hafen.map empties out and carries the two relations instead — markers (the old hafen.markers) and icons (the old hafen.radar, re-shaped as a callable namespace over IconCat entities) — and both hard-cut namespaces read plain nil.
